title: barista node.json
description: Node.js registry (user level ~/.barista/node.json); missing file means an empty registry

installations.description: Registered Node.js installations in declaration order

name.description: Unique logical name (auto-named node-<version> by add/install, e.g. node-22.14.0)

version.description: Full version string without the v prefix (e.g. 22.14.0)

path.description: Absolute node home (the distribution root; node.exe at the root on Windows, bin/node elsewhere)

managed.description: True when installed by barista node install (under installDir); eligible for barista node uninstall

default.description: Name of the default Node.js installation (set by barista node set-default); overridden by workspace properties.json "node"

installDir.description: Install root for barista node install (set by barista node set-install-dir); must be an absolute path (~ allowed); default is the builtin ~/.barista/toolchains/node
